name: Toy Scanner
description: Names the display a held toy belongs to, highlights it across the shop, and pins the exact spot of a carried part's other half instead of just its aisle.

name: Sorting Trolley
description: Wheel three toys at once instead of one. Aim at another toy and press E to load it, Q to cycle what you are holding.

name: Grippy Sneakers
description: Cross the shop floor a third faster without skidding into a display.

name: Long-Handled Grabber
description: Reach further into a pile, so a toy no longer has to be underfoot to pick up.

name: Manager's Nod
description: The next twenty-five toys on the wrong shelf still count as mistakes, but cost you no time.
